subject: general
question: The average of 17 numbers is 48. The average of the first 9 numbers is 45 and the average of the last 9 numbers is 52. If 9th number is excluded, then 60% of the average of the remaining number is:
solution:
Average of 17 numbers = 48

Sum of 17 numbers = 48 × 17 = 816

The average of first 9 numbers = 45

Sum of first 9 numbers = 45 × 9 = 405

Average of last 9 numbers = 52

Sum of last 9 numbers = 52 × 9 = 468

9th number = 405 + 468 – 816 = 57

Sum of 16 numbers = 816 – 57 = 759

Average of 16 numbers = 759/16

∴ 60% of average of 16 numbers = 759/16 × 60/100 = 28.4625
